projects.practical_disposition: Phase 1 remains preserved with final result APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. The user-approved and durably registered Phase 1 zero-cost research space was exhausted without a prospectively validated candidate; that scoped result and every Phase 1 artifact remain unchanged. In Phase 2, all 36 mean-reversion v2 development files passed exact byte identity, real PyArrow parsing, and representative-row checks, but the full production session-grid path exceeded its bounded wall time. A live independent Sol/xhigh audit returned IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED_REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: the remaining indexing defect appears mechanically repairable without changing the frozen economic hypothesis, so the exact experiment is nonterminal, the family was neither economically evaluated nor consumed, and neither DATA_NO_GO nor HISTORICAL_NO_GO applies. Route 2 is not authorized while route 1 remains nonterminal; additional human repair authorization is required. No Phase 2 economic result, strategy P&L, candidate, or prospective evidence exists; every final holdout remains closed and unread, capital remains zero, and no profitability conclusion is permitted.
